title: mimid-agent-jmap: surface Event::IdentityChanged and did_webvh membership to JMAP clients
description: draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-01 §Reference Identifiers: MUST alert the user if a contact's SCID changes; §Negotiation: SHOULD indicate which members are authenticated by did_webvh. mimid-agent-core reports Event::IdentityChanged and Agent::clients() (leaf, user, SCID) since bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.18, but the JMAP layer (crates/mimid-agent-jmap) drops IdentityChanged and shows no per-member did_webvh status. Needs a JMAP Chat representation (crate-jmap / jmap-chat-spec write needs Mark's OK).
notes:
Decided by Mark 2026-11-17: (1) an in-chat notice message when a contact's SCID changes, in mimid-agent-jmap; (3) proper JMAP Chat properties for did_webvh status and identity change in jmap-chat-spec and crate-jmap. No mimid-only extra fields. Per AGENTS.md each write to jmap-chat-spec / crate-jmap still needs Mark's OK on the text when it happens.
Part 3 done: jmap-chat-spec 1018d37 (didChangedAt, MAY), crate-jmap 83a08405 (field, server-set, tests, public-api). ChatContact.did already existed in both; the agent sets it (part of the follow-ups agent's work). Setting didChangedAt from mimid needs the crate-jmap rev bump (mimid-1wgh.11.10).
close_reason: Part (1) done in 3cdc553: mimid-agent-jmap stores one plain-text notice Message per room and per (user, pinned SCID, presented SCID) when the agent raises Event::IdentityChanged (SCID changed, or a BasicCredential device for a pinned contact); body names the contact (displayName else user URI), says the identity changed and asks to verify; senderId = the accountId (JMAP Chat has no system sender and mimid-agent-jmap had no convention; a made-up ChatContact would look like a person; the account's own agent wrote it, so it cannot read as from the contact). Idempotent: keyed in the senderMsgId random part (SHA-256 of room/user/SCIDs), rebuilt on restore; a replay or a re-raise at a later Commit stores nothing. Coordinator addition: ChatContact.did = the contact's did:webvh DID (head DID document id), updated with the notice, none for BasicCredential contacts; capability not advertised (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.29). No mimid-only properties. Test: crates/mimid-agent-jmap/tests/didwebvh_contacts.rs (real server; DIDs from the controller's own log; second Commit re-raises the event and still one notice; mutation without the idempotency key fails with 2). Part (3) (JMAP Chat properties in jmap-chat-spec/crate-jmap) moved to mimid-1wgh.4.81.30. Feedback item 27.
